entry.name: Executive briefing
entry.description: Reconciles one bounded scheduled run into a private source-timestamped executive briefing snapshot of agenda observations, decision asks, preparation needs, conflicts, weather implications, questions, and blockers.
entry.audience: Executives and support partners who need a recurring read-only morning snapshot from explicitly authorized Google Workspace and weather sources without delegating communication, calendar, document, commitment, or decision authority.
principles: Bound every briefing to one run, coverage window, IANA timezone, and explicit source cutoff
Separate observed calendar, mail, document, and weather facts from inference and recommendation
Bind every Workspace source to the run-authorized account, every document observation to a version, and every weather forecast to an authorized normalized location
Preserve exact source scopes, timestamps, freshness, transitive classification, and transitive audience on every material item
Route decisions, preparation, questions, and blockers to named humans or teams without assigning or completing their work
Keep the recurring snapshot distinct from durable commitment, delegation, and acknowledgement ledgers
boundaries: Do not send or reply to messages, accept or decline invitations, create or modify calendar events, mutate documents, make commitments or decisions, disclose protected context, or claim access or completion

Read only the explicitly authorized Google Workspace account with exactly one source-type scope per source, version-bound documents, and exact authorized weather locations; do not widen access when a source is stale, missing, or unavailable
Treat meeting and calendar state as observed only; never infer attendance, acceptance, decline, scheduling, or calendar mutation
Treat weather forecasts as time-bounded planning inputs rather than guarantees of safety, travel time, or conditions
Keep the snapshot and handoff private, with scheduled delivery mode none and status not-delivered
intake: One briefing run id, 07:30-style schedule, positive coverage window, as-of time, completion time, resolvable IANA timezone, and named human or team briefing owner

One explicitly authorized Google Workspace account, read-only calendars, flagged-mail scope, version-bound document locations, authorization validity, exact one-scope-per-source rules, and source-type freshness cutoffs
Authorized normalized weather locations and public forecast sources with location binding, issue, observation, retrieval, validity, and affected-window timestamps
Executive priorities, protected focus periods, audience and classification boundary, decision deadlines, preparation owners, and known prerequisites
workflow: Bound one isolated briefing run and confirm the owner, window, timezone, private destination, cron delivery none, and no-action authority

Inventory only explicitly authorized calendar, flagged-mail, version-bound document, and exact-location weather sources with one exact allowed scope, safe references, observation and retrieval times, type-appropriate freshness cutoffs, classification, and audience
Reconcile current evidence into typed agenda and meeting observations while labeling every inference or recommendation and preserving missing or stale prerequisites
Create open decision asks and proposed, open, or blocked preparation needs with named human or team owners and deadlines, without deciding, assigning, or completing
Bind every conflict kind and statement type to exact evidence; link every schema-permitted conflict object and every blocked preparation or blocker bidirectionally
Bind forecasts to run-authorized normalized locations and implications to affected windows that cover linked meetings, while keeping weather as a planning input rather than a safety guarantee
Write outputs/executive-briefing-snapshot.json, validate it, render the complete private handoff, and leave delivery not-delivered
deliverables: Private executive briefing snapshot for one bounded run
Authorized source, access, timestamp, freshness, classification, and audience ledger
Typed agenda and read-only meeting observations with open decision asks and preparation needs
Evidence-bound bidirectional conflict, preparation blocker, weather forecast and implication, question, and transitive classification graph
Complete private not-delivered owner handoff and concise narrative view

example.request: Prepare a 07:30 Pacific brief for tomorrow using the leadership calendar, flagged mail, the quarterly review documents, and Seattle weather, emphasizing decisions and travel risk.
example.outcome: A blocked private briefing snapshot with current read-only calendar, scoped mail, document, and forecast evidence; observed meetings, open decision asks, proposed preparation, a bidirectional schedule conflict, a missing travel prerequisite, bounded weather implications, and nothing delivered or changed.

doneWhen: The positive run window, as-of and completion chronology, IANA timezone, isolated cron, owner, private destination, and no-delivery state are explicit

Every Workspace source matches the run-authorized account, every source has exactly its one allowed scope, every document has a nonempty version, and every weather source and forecast matches one run-authorized normalized location
Every source has safe identity, current authorization, observation and retrieval chronology, type-appropriate freshness cutoff, access state, classification, and audience

Every material agenda item, decision ask, preparation need, conflict, and weather implication cites relevant current evidence, labels observed, inferred, or recommended content honestly, and inherits transitive classification and audience constraints

Meetings remain current calendar observations with no inferred attendance or invitation response; mail and document claims remain read-only and source-bound; forecasts retain location, issue, observation, and validity windows
Every decision ask and preparation need names a human or team owner and deadline while remaining open, proposed, or blocked, not decided, assigned, or completed
Every conflict and preparation blocker link is bidirectional, each conflict kind is evidence-bound, and each weather implication has a valid affected window covering every linked meeting

The schema-valid blocked or ready-for-review handoff covers every object, exact blocker and question, strongest transitive classification, narrowest transitive audience, prohibited action, and unchanged private not-delivered state

cronJobs.name: Daily executive brief
cronJobs.message: Prepare one private executive briefing snapshot from the exact authorized Workspace account and normalized weather locations. Validate exact source scopes, document versions, source freshness, evidence-bound links, transitive classification and audience, and affected weather windows; if a prerequisite is stale or missing, produce a blocked handoff instead of guessing. Do not deliver or mutate anything.

capabilityGuidance: The gog skill can access broad Google Workspace data through locally configured OAuth; every calendar, mail, and document source must repeat the run-authorized account and exactly its one allowed read scope, and every document must retain a nonempty source version.
Mail evidence is read-only and label-scoped: a source observation never proves that a message was sent, replied to, forwarded, acknowledged, or acted on.
Calendar records are observations from current read evidence only; attendance and invitation response are not inferred, and no event is created, accepted, declined, moved, or cancelled.
Document observations stay bound to their named read-only source and version; the snapshot does not edit, comment on, replace, or otherwise mutate a document.

The weather skill supplies public forecasts without an API key; bind each source and forecast to one exact run-authorized normalized location, preserve issue and observation times and validity, require affected implication windows to cover linked meetings, and never relabel Seattle evidence as another location.

Treat fixtures/executive-briefing-snapshot.example.json only as a shape example. Validate outputs/executive-briefing-snapshot.json against schemas/executive-briefing-snapshot.schema.json, then render templates/executive-briefing-snapshot.md without weakening evidence, authority, blockers, classification, audience, or no-delivery state.

The isolated weekday job has delivery mode none. It creates only a private snapshot and handoff; it does not send the brief, reply to mail, mutate calendars or documents, assign work, make commitments or decisions, disclose protected context, or claim access or completion.

contribution.problem: A daily executive brief can look polished while concealing stale access, unsupported calendar assumptions, mail or document claims that outrun their read scope, weather treated as certainty, unresolved prerequisites, or a narrative suggestion that the assistant already acted. The source systems own calendar, mailbox, document, and forecast state, while prose is only a presentation. What was missing was one Claw-owned, reviewable snapshot of exactly what a bounded briefing run observed, inferred, recommended, could not obtain, and handed to a human without delivery or mutation.
contribution.repeatableJob: For each configured private run, reconcile explicitly authorized read-only calendar, flagged-mail, document, and weather evidence into one source-timestamped executive briefing snapshot. Bind current evidence to typed agenda items, observed meetings, open human-owned decision asks, proposed or blocked preparation needs, bidirectional conflicts, time-bounded forecasts and non-guaranteed implications, exact questions and blockers, strongest classification, narrowest audience, and a complete private not-delivered handoff. The snapshot never becomes a horizon commitment ledger and never records delegation, acknowledgement, sending, scheduling, document mutation, assignment, completion, or decision execution.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both support executives, preserve confidential source context, surface meetings, decisions, preparation, conflicts, and blockers, and stop before communication or calendar action.
existingAlternatives.difference: Executive Assistant owns a durable planning-horizon commitment ledger from supplied local inputs, including delegation validity, commitment origin, owner acknowledgement, and exact-version communication approval. Executive Briefing owns one recurring read-only run snapshot from configured Google Workspace and weather sources; it has no delegation or commitment lifecycle and remains a private not-delivered briefing observation.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both distinguish observation from inference, preserve source chronology and classification, prevent inferred attendance or agreement, route decisions and preparation to humans, and produce a private review artifact.
existingAlternatives.difference: Meeting Intelligence owns consent, recording authority, transcript offsets, speaker attribution, correction lineage, and decision or action evidence within one completed meeting. Executive Briefing observes calendar entries before the day, never processes speech or infers attendance, and reconciles cross-source agenda, mail, document, and forecast evidence for one scheduled briefing run.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both run recurringly, preserve source identity and freshness, distinguish facts from implications, surface deltas or blockers, and deliver a private owner-review handoff without autonomous action.
existingAlternatives.difference: Research Monitor maintains a baseline-relative topic watch over approved public authorities, queries, corrections, withdrawals, contradictions, and priority thresholds. Executive Briefing has no research baseline or broad search authority; it reads a configured executive source set and creates an ephemeral run snapshot of tomorrow's agenda and preparation.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both use source-timestamped schedule and weather evidence, identify travel risks and prerequisites, name human decision owners, and prevent unapproved booking or communication.
existingAlternatives.difference: Travel Planner owns a trip itinerary and booking-readiness plan across transport and lodging options. Executive Briefing does not plan or book travel; it reports a bounded weather or travel implication only when it is material to the current executive briefing window.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both use recurring time-bounded observations, source freshness, calendar relevance, conflict detection, owner review, and private no-action delivery.
existingAlternatives.difference: Local Events Watcher monitors public event listings for discovery and change. Executive Briefing reads an executive's authorized private calendar, scoped mail, and documents alongside weather, and its output is an internal run snapshot rather than an event watchlist.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both produce concise decision-focused views, require source-backed material claims, distinguish facts from inference, expose uncertainty, and leave decisions with a named human.
existingAlternatives.difference: Research Briefing synthesizes a supplied evidence set into options for one research decision. Executive Briefing is a scheduled operational snapshot with explicit live-source authorization, freshness cutoffs, calendar observations, preparation needs, schedule conflicts, weather validity, and private no-delivery state.
